purpose: Reviewed source-only portal baseline for cloud fixes; not a deployment or blanket production-tree import.

adjustments.change: Omitted local UserSecretsId metadata; no secret contents copied.

exclusions: AppHost provisioning and legacy Server changes
Unrelated test projects outside required reference closure
Generated wwwroot/css/app.css (regenerate from committed Tailwind source)
All local uncommitted work, binaries, keys, databases, build output and original private history
